digest.component_or_area: reconciler core backend abstraction & jira adapter
propositions: Reconciler core currently reaches into Jira adapter directly with no named interface; a second backend cannot implement compatibility
Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and RemoteRef identity type must be defined in _backend.py to enable multi-backend support
JiraBackend thin wrapper must delegate to existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields) with zero behavior change and no core call site rewiring
Capability detection via isinstance checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must work without a capabilities() method

Backend-agnostic contract test suite must pass when parameterized over both JiraBackend with injected mock transport and FakeBackend, and characterization tests must prove mapper outputs are byte-for-byte identical to current main
